changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0047. Snapshot membership pricing and store membership payments separately. Index review: PK on MembershipPayments.Id; IX_MembershipPayments_TenantId_MembershipId_PaymentDate for history; IX_MembershipPayments_TenantId_MemberProfileId_PaymentDate for member views; IX_MembershipPayments_TenantId_Status for posted sums. Backfill PackagePrice/FinalAmount/Currency from current plan so existing memberships remain collectible. Performance note: every list index leads with TenantId. Soft-deleted and voided payments stay out of outstanding sums via Status.
